notes: Every coordinate is on the 0.25 grid. All geometry is hand-authored and explicitly stored below, including knockout subpaths.
geometry maps each master id to its exact SVG shapes and attributes. SVG files remain the conversion source. Validation checks them against this specification.
Strokes are 2, with 2.25 clock hands and 2.5 sun rays or selected line glyphs. Caps and joins are round. Every element uses currentColor.
Filled variants retain the base first contour. Sun and moon already use solid centres in the approved design and share geometry with their fill variants.
Shared monochrome icon masters for the Windows renderer and public website. Geometry is independent of platform-specific consumers.
